note: Joint circles read from concept-art/characters/kaze/kaze-rig-cores-v1-frente.png (x, y) and -perfil.png (y) in pixels; build_blender_assets converts them to metres on the generated model.

face.note: Flat face patch in metres on the scaled model: half width, bottom/top Z, front Y cut. The expression atlas (godot/assets/characters/<id>/textures/face.png) is projected from the front over the square x in [-half, half], z in [bottom, bottom + 2*half].
